设计意图： Crossover of two qualified drawdown-based factors. Primary mechanism: drawdown depth normalized by ATR (63-day) from drawdown_depth_atr. Lightweight modifier: regime gating from drawdown_stress_ratio_gated that dampens the signal by 50% during high residual volatility to reduce noise. The cross-sectional rank transform enhances comparability across assets as relative drawdown severity is economica

因子路由 / 公式 ⚠ FE DSL 暂不支持

depth = -((close / ts_max(63, close) - 1)); normalized = depth / ts_mean(63, true_range); result = if high_resvol then normalized * 0.5 else normalized
依赖列: open, high, low, close, volume, style_gate_resvol_high

🧮 计算步骤（通俗版，已合并重复/中间变量）

  1. 1. where —— 条件选择/防除零保护
    where((ts_std(ts_pct(AdjClose, 1), 20) > 0), multiply(⊗1, 0.5), ⊗1)
  2. 2. ts_std —— 过去 N 天滚动标准差
    ts_std(ts_pct(AdjClose, 1), 20)
  3. 3. ts_pct —— 过去 N 天变化率
    ts_pct(AdjClose, 1)
  4. 4. multiply —— 乘法
    multiply(⊗1, 0.5)
使用字段：
列含义说明
AdjClose后复权收盘复权后的收盘价，动量/收益类计算常用
AdjHigh后复权最高复权后的当日最高价
AdjLow后复权最低复权后的当日最低价

🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
ts_pctd 期变化率：(x − x_shift(d)) / x_shift(d)

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 1) 计算滚动 N 日 close 高点 peak
  2. 2) depth = (peak - close) / peak 回撤深度 (0~1)
  3. 3) atr = ts_atr(high, low, close, 14) ATR 平均真实波幅
  4. 4) normalized = depth / (atr / close) ATR 归一化 (波动调整后)
  5. 5) 高波动期 (high_resvol=True): 乘 0.5 (半权重)
  6. 6) 低波动期: 原始 normalized
  7. 7) factor = cs_rank(...)
来源：手写步骤（factor_manual_61 / formula_lqtp 人工核对）

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_drawdown_depth_atr_gated(df): df_copy = df.copy() peak = df_copy["close"].rolling(63, min_periods=63).max() dd = (df_copy["close"] - peak) / peak depth = (-dd) high_low = df_copy["high"] - df_copy["low"] high_close = (df_copy["high"] - df_copy["close"].shift(1)).abs() low_close = (df_copy["low"] - df_copy["close"].shift(1)).abs() tr = pd.concat([high_low, high_close, low_close], axis=1).max(axis=1) atr = tr.rolling(63, min_periods=63).mean() normalized_depth = depth / atr.replace(0, np.nan) high_resvol = df_copy["style_gate_resvol_high"] > 0 factor_values = np.where(high_resvol, normalized_depth * 0.5, normalized_depth) factor_values = pd.Series(factor_values, index=df_copy.index) factor_values.name = "factor_drawdown_depth_atr_gated" "kw">class="kw">return factor_values
